title: Case 050: Customer requests reimbursement of a guaranteed-delivery surcharge after confirmed delay

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The fictional guaranteed-delivery service missed its deadline. The carrier’s narrow guarantee covers only the surcharge, subject to billing approval.
initial_request: My parcel arrived at 08:40, later than the guaranteed 08:00 deadline. Please submit a request for the GBP 7.50 service surcharge under these booking terms.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Submit a service-guarantee request to the carrier with the confirmed timestamps and applicable fictional booking terms.

outcome: The authorised billing team confirms the approved surcharge credit and reference; other losses are outside this case.
boundaries: The delay is 40 minutes; do not multiply the surcharge or promise compensation for unrelated losses. Posted credit is not money received.

events.body: DL-050 booking terms excerpt: guaranteed by 2026-03-23 08:00 UTC; surcharge GBP 7.50. If carrier-caused delay is confirmed, the surcharge may be credited after billing review. Route record: carrier sorting delay, actual recipient handover 2026-03-23 08:40 UTC. No exclusion is recorded.
My parcel arrived at 08:40, later than the guaranteed 08:00 deadline. Please submit a request for the GBP 7.50 service surcharge under these booking terms.

Please review a service-guarantee credit request for DL-050: guaranteed 2026-03-23 08:00 UTC, actual handover 08:40, confirmed carrier sorting delay, surcharge GBP 7.50. Customer seeks only the surcharge under this booking’s terms.

Approved after review: credit GC-050 for GBP 7.50 against DL-050’s service surcharge. The credit is posted to the fictional booking account. This is not a cash transfer and does not compensate any other loss.
